subject.title: fix(cron): support current and session: targets in initial delivery resolution

question: Should direct `CronService.add` and declarative-convergence callers implicitly persist announce delivery for `current` and `session:*`, or must those defaults remain owned by `normalizeCronJobCreate`?
rationale: The choice changes message-delivery defaults and persisted job semantics outside the already normalized public creation paths, so implementation evidence alone cannot establish the intended product contract.

options.title: Keep normalization canonical
options.body: Route supported direct and declarative creation through the normalizer or require explicit delivery, avoiding a second target-policy implementation.

options.title: Expand the service contract
options.body: Retain implicit announce in `resolveInitialCronDelivery` after confirming that all direct callers should receive it and adding changed-path live and compatibility proof.

recommendation.title: Keep normalization canonical
recommendation.body: Route supported direct and declarative creation through the normalizer or require explicit delivery, avoiding a second target-policy implementation.

likelyOwner.reason: The closest explicit session-target product contract and landing approval are associated with the merged persistent-session restoration.
